_comment: Listener catalogue commands (spec §14.2 F, §46.7). Read by BOTH sides:
TypeScript wrappers emit these payloads and parse these responses;
- src-tauri/tests/ipc_contract_tests.rs asserts the Rust DTOs produce
them and that the download commands are still honest stubs.
download_listener and cancel_listener_download are deliberately absent:
they return NOT_IMPLEMENTED because no CandidCue pack host exists, and the
UI shows no download affordance rather than a button that does nothing.

expectedCatalogueEntry.description: A calm listener who holds eye contact.
